name: @naijacloud/cli
description: Command-line interface for NaijaCloud hosting: authenticate, and manage projects, services, deployments, domains and environment variables. Also serves those operations to AI agents over MCP via `naijacloud mcp`.
author: Fawaz Adebayo <fawaz.adebayo.ajibola@gmail.com> (https://github.com/Pherwerz)
//bin: `njc` is a short alias for the same entrypoint. Not `nc`, which is netcat on virtually every Unix machine.

scripts.//clean:build: Only build/, which is all the npm tarball contains. `clean` also removes the release artifacts, and prepublishOnly must not do that — the Homebrew and Scoop steps run after `npm publish` and read dist-packaging/.
scripts.//binary: Standalone executable for Homebrew / apt / yum / Scoop / WinGet, built with `bun build --compile`. Defaults to the host platform; `binary:all` cross-compiles every target from any machine.
scripts.binary:all: npm run build && node scripts/build-binary.mjs --target all
scripts.//prepare: Runs on `npm install` and on `npm install -g .`, so a fresh clone gets a usable build/cli.js without a separate step.
scripts.//version: Runs after `npm version` writes the new number and before it makes the bump commit, so the regenerated schema lands *in* that commit. schema/naijacloud.schema.json embeds the version in x-generated-by, so bumping without rebuilding leaves it stale and CI fails the check on the next push. Only fires for `npm version` — hand-editing the version field skips it.
scripts.version: npm run build && git add schema/naijacloud.schema.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean:build && npm run build
